description: This file defines the OpenIdUserIdentity entity class within the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_openid_user_identity' database table. It models the relationship between users and their OpenID providers, including user identity details.

classes.name: OpenIdUserIdentity
classes.description: Entity class representing OpenID user identity associations in OrangeHRM, including references to User and OpenIdProvider entities.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User associated with this OpenIdUserIdentity.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the User associated with this OpenIdUserIdentity.

methods.name: getOpenIdProvider
methods.description: Returns the OpenIdProvider associated with this identity.

methods.name: setOpenIdProvider
methods.description: Sets the OpenIdProvider for this identity.
